concepts.name: public-context-desktop
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished production-grade interface DESIGN CONCEPT for EMAD, a geospatial evidence and native simulation platform. The image is a reviewed design reference, never live application evidence. Flat enterprise product design, exceptionally clear legible typography and hierarchy, graphite global navigation, quiet neutral light panels, subdued teal selected state, amber partial/delayed states, red only errors. Restrained 4/8 px spacing, thin dividers, no shadows, no decorative gradients, no hacker green, no fake radar, no decorative statistics, no marketing hero. Carefully use distinct public evidence and simulated-workspace identity, visibly named mode, account role, scope and time basis. Exact factual data, dates, source notes, labels, marks and controls will remain editable/data-bound in the application; show only short representative interface labels here, never invent scientific conclusions or current events. Small caption 'DESIGN CONCEPT · SCHEMATIC GEOGRAPHY · NOT LIVE DATA'. Do not copy a branded third party UI. Do not portray this design as an implemented product. Wide desktop screen 16:10, the complete proposed Public Context Explore workspace filling the image. Compact global topbar EMAD / Public Context selected / Simulation inactive, workspace Saudi context, analyst identity, separate Connection connected status. Under it compact navigation Explore selected, Imagery, Assessments, Context packages. A slim left utility icon rail. Left 250px panel Layers / Sources tabs, geography group boundaries, coastline, major routes, places; evidence group USGS, FIRMS, station weather, external tracks; separate frozen imagery footprint. All features visually grouped with modest checkbox, swatch and source-state text. Center map dominates 65% width and most height: geographically plausible western Saudi Arabia / Red Sea / Jeddah coast, subdued pale sand land, muted blue sea, thin grey roads, clear city labels and a dashed bounded Jeddah AOI. No fictional fire spots, airplane traffic, or invented evidence. Active region breadcrumb Saudi Arabia > Jeddah, horizontal contextual toolbar with Search places, Region, time selection. Right 290px inspector selects Jeddah coastal context, geographic reference / retained historical imagery, not an activity claim; preview thumbnail and useful actions Open imagery and Prepare context. Source coverage strip includes FIRMS initial backfill, AIS access required and show coverage. At bottom narrow timeline with clearly Historical Mar 2025 vs Current tabs and counts labelled within selected view, source date visible. No old controlled asset, mission, command or telemetry widgets on this public screen. Map and legend, source state and caveat remain visible when panels collapse. Communicate functionality through strong composition rather than tiny unreadable copy. Keyboard focus ring example on the selected region action; controls have generous click targets.
concepts.revisionPrompt: Edit this EMAD UI design concept. Keep the attractive shell, desktop tri-pane composition, map dominance and readable type. This is a layout mockup with schematic geography, not installed data. Correct these misleading labels carefully: Administrative boundaries attribution must be Natural Earth, never GADM. Major routes in the national reference are Natural Earth. Rename ALL 'FIRMS (active fires)' to 'FIRMS · thermal detections', keeping Initial backfill; thermal detections are not confirmed fires. Station weather source state must be 'Stale' in amber, never Available; station source NOAA / Aviation Weather. Rename external tracks AIS source to AISStream and keep Access required. In bottom strip remove all invented image items/counts/dates. Display exactly TWO thumbnail slots labeled '01 Mar 2025' and '31 Mar 2025', and a simple text 'Retained comparison pair'. Selected date must be 01 Mar 2025, never Mar 3. No 12 imagery items claim, no March 7,15,19,23,27 invented captures. Use other space for 'Scene catalogue' link. Before/after dates, sources, status and all labels will be real data-bound elements in implementation. Keep small DESIGN CONCEPT · SCHEMATIC GEOGRAPHY · NOT LIVE DATA caption. Do not add facts. Flat solid colors only, remove gradient or shadow decoration. The purpose is spatial workflow hierarchy.

concepts.revisionPrompt: Edit this EMAD Studio layout concept, preserving professional spatial-editor composition, dominant viewport, hierarchy rail, inspector and timeline. Correct fidelity and workflow promises: Top role should be 'Scenario author', not Operator (Analyst). Rename the prominent start button 'Start frozen version', and put visible 'Draft edits are not running' text near draft status. Replace Sensor Preset EO (Standard) with 'Abstract sensor preset', never imply calibrated electro-optical modeling. Remove unsupported Endurance and Comm Range fields; replace that advanced section with 'Fidelity: Abstract kinematic' and 'Altitude datum: WGS84 ellipsoid'. Remove meaningless historic frozen date2024; show 'Frozen version · exact revision pinned'. Left library must show six classes fixed-wing aircraft, UAV, helicopter, ground vehicle, vessel, stationary sensor; no Building or Port crane asset promises. Thumbnails representative only. Spatial screenshot is illustrative; reduce cinematic aerial realism/skyline and exaggerated vast city/aircraft to clearly bounded schematic coast terrain with simple building extrusion, no huge city-detail upgrade implied. UAV should be selected with a modest marker and focus inset rather than appearing enormous at city scale. Route and waypoint geometry only belong to AUTHORING / EXERCISE INPUT mode. Bottom caveat 'Abstract movement · surface model · estimated heights'. Keep DESIGN CONCEPT · SCHEMATIC GEOGRAPHY · NOT LIVE DATA. Flat colors/no ornamental gradients/shadows.

The image is a reviewed design reference, never live application evidence. Flat enterprise product design, exceptionally clear legible typography and hierarchy, graphite global navigation, quiet neutral light panels, subdued teal selected state, amber partial/delayed states, red only errors. Restrained 4/8 px spacing, thin dividers, no shadows, no decorative gradients, no hacker green, no fake radar, no decorative statistics, no marketing hero. Small caption 'DESIGN CONCEPT · SCHEMATIC GEOGRAPHY · NOT LIVE DATA'. Do not copy a branded third party UI. Do not portray this design as an implemented product. Create one clean design presentation board containing THREE clearly separated complete device screen concepts at readable scale: (A) mobile portrait Public Context Explore about 390x844; (B) mobile portrait imagery comparison about 390x844; (C) mobile landscape exercise replay about 844x390, arranged below or beside. White board with brief captions, no fake physical phone bezels or shiny mockup shadows. Same graphite global bar and teal/neutrals as desktop. A: compact EMAD / Public badge, Jeddah selected region and Historical March 2025 date, large coastal map visibly occupying majority of screen, single selected AOI, bottom sheet preview Jeddah coastal context with source/date/retained state and Open imagery action, bottom tabs Explore Imagery Assessments, Layers and Search floating button with at least 44px touch areas, collapsed status 'FIRMS backfill / AIS access required'; no fictional real detections or craft. B: large comparison viewport using actual-like Sentinel-2 Jeddah texture, before March 1 / after March 31 2025 clearly labelled, accessible horizontal compare handle plus side-by-side option, selected image dates and quality mask control always visible; short evidence detail sheet 'Indicator only · human review required', Compare action, no invented NDVI numbers. C: landscape recorded exercise perception replay with SYNTHETIC · RECORDED · OPERATOR explicit badge, large dark 3D coast surface, only a perceived contact uncertainty ellipse and a separately styled controlled UAV telemetry symbol with legend, unknown contact altitude text, compact bottom play/pause + previous/next event + seeking + speed, virtual clock, no hidden actors/routes/sensors/world truth. Mobile filters live in bottom sheets which can close and return focus to map; screen depicts closed state or half-height preview, never a wall of controls over map. Source/date/partial status survive all view sizes; offline/reconnect design retains last view with timestamp rather than blanking it. Reduced motion no autoplay; camera/geolocation permissions not requested. Labels illustrate hierarchy; no fabricated current scientific facts. Caption all geography schematic and concepts not live data.
concepts.revisionPrompt: Edit this responsive EMAD concept board preserving all three layouts: mobile portrait map, mobile portrait imagery and landscape operator replay. Correct the left phone amber card: it must contain two distinct rows 'FIRMS · initial backfill · Partial' and 'AIS · access required'. FIRMS must NOT say access required because its key is configured. Remove any ambiguous Access required under FIRMS. In imagery phone make quality toggle label 'Quality mask' and add small legend 'Cloud / shadow / invalid' or show overlay only when enabled; do not imply image change is verified loss. In landscape replay replace absolute UTC-looking timestamp near playback with 'Virtual time', keep 00:02:18 of15min marked illustrative. No fabricated captured-run timing claims; this is schematic layout, not actual recording evidence. Keep persistent SYNTHETIC · RECORDED · OPERATOR. Uncertainty area is schematic here and would require actual observation uncertainty fields; unknown altitude stays unknown. Retain only known controlled telemetry and one perceived contact, never hidden truth/route/sensor configuration. Labels and data will remain editable, nothing baked into production geography. Add succinct overall 'LAYOUT CONCEPTS · ALL GEOGRAPHY AND CONTACTS ILLUSTRATIVE'. No stylized lighting, gradients, glows or drop shadows. Same typography and teal/neutral palette as desktops.

knownCaveats: Generated artwork is a review aid, not an exact scientific or cartographic rendering.
Studio thumbnails and actor list illustrate UI organization; the installed ready scene has four actors and six reusable actor model classes.
Source states in concepts illustrate the audit snapshot and are not current live health.
No implementation approval has been recorded.
